verdict.rationale: The release notes describe one specific bulk-operation feature: batching small same-shape tasks into a single subagent dispatch (with batch review verifying every file made it into the diff), which cuts cost on micro-task plans. This is a narrow, workflow-specific implementation of 'bulk operations' rather than a general-purpose capability for operating across arbitrary large item sets. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations outside the SDD task-dispatch context (e.g., bulk file edits, bulk data/API operations across many items), independent hands-on confirmation of the batching feature's reliability, and scale limits/thresholds for what counts as 'many items'.
